final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate * 1.0 / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS rebate_fee_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY o.timespan), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS mean_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.rebate_fee_ratio, s.record_count, s.record_count - m.mean_count AS count_difference FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS m WHERE m.mean_count IS NOT NULL AND s.record_count > m.mean_count) SELECT AVG(rebate_fee_ratio), SUM(record_count), AVG(count_difference) FROM step3
